from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Extracted metrics from one university's document for Transfer Integration Score calculation."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university, e.g., 'DePaul University'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Time period of the data, e.g., 'Fall 2021' or '2020-2021'")
    total_undergraduates: float | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate population (Section B1)")
    enrolled_transfer_students: float | None = Field(description="Enrolled degree-seeking transfer students (Section D2)")
    transfer_applicants: float | None = Field(description="Total transfer applicants (Section D2)")
    first_year_applicants: float | None = Field(description="First-time, first-year applicants (Section C1)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityMetrics]
